title: Classic Filipino Menudo
description: A hearty breakfast dish made with pork and liver, cooked in a flavorful tomato-based sauce.

ingredients.name: Pork, cut into small cubes
ingredients.notes: You can use pork shoulder or pork belly

ingredients.name: Pork liver, cut into small pieces
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or frozen pork liver

ingredients.name: Onion, chopped
ingredients.notes: You can use yellow or white onion

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or frozen garlic

ingredients.name: Tomato, crushed
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or canned tomatoes

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: You can use patis or fish sauce

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or ground black pepper

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: You can use kosher or sea salt

ingredients.name: Chili peppers, sliced
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or dried chili peppers

ingredients.name: Bay leaves
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or dried bay leaves

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pork liver and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crushed tomato, fish sauce, black pepper, and salt. Stir well.
Add the chili peppers and bay leaves. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a squeeze of lime juice.
